text: Which prestige real estate agencies in Perth are the market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing?

sections.text:
For Perth’s **luxury off-the-plan apartments, penthouses and design-led developments**, the strongest shortlist is:

- **Jones Realty & Projects** — the clearest market leader for specialist project marketing. It focuses on development feasibility, positioning, branding, off-the-plan sales and settlement, and reports more than $1 billion in projects sold or selling.[1] Jones was also reported as REIWA’s top office for Residential Project Marketing, with Nicole Jones ranked top salesperson in the category.[3]
- **PRD Real Estate Perth** — a major full-service project-marketing firm with experience across apartment and mixed-use developments. Its Perth operation reports close to $1 billion in off-the-plan and completed apartment sales, plus support spanning site acquisition, product design, pricing, positioning and marketing.[2]
- **Contessi Properties** — a suitable boutique option for high-end and prestige residential property, including luxury sales, off-market campaigns, buyer advocacy and project sales and marketing.[7]
- **Prestige Property International** — relevant where the brief involves an integrated luxury development, from design concept and site acquisition through project management, sales and marketing, and asset management.[8]
- **Harcourts Prestige South or Prestige North** — credible project-sales options for land estates, subdivisions and house-and-land developments, although they appear more oriented toward broader development and growth-corridor work than penthouse-led architectural projects.[9][10]

## Best fit by brief

| Requirement | Strongest candidates |
|---|---|
| Luxury apartment or penthouse launch | Jones Realty & Projects; PRD Perth |
| Architectural, design-led project | Jones Realty & Projects; Prestige Property International |
| Boutique prestige/off-market campaign | Contessi Properties |
| End-to-end development advisory | Jones Realty & Projects; PRD Perth; Prestige Property International |
| Land subdivision or house-and-land project | Harcourts Prestige South/North |

**Practical recommendation:** invite **Jones, PRD Perth and Contessi** to pitch first. Jones has the strongest independently reported project-marketing credentials in the available results; PRD offers scale and a long apartment-sales track record; Contessi may provide a more boutique, prestige-focused campaign. For a truly architectural project, assess each agency’s recent comparable launches, buyer database, international-channel capability, creative standard, sell-through rate and evidence of achieved—not merely advertised—pricing.
